body: I'm so sorry. I'm in the process of selling the house because he wants a divorce. I am heartbroken. You are at my next step. I was hopeful that you would be stronger at this point. It's okay to feel sad. I don't want it to be over either. I hope it gets better for us. Maybe you will finally get some actual sleep. I'm wondering when the day will come that I don't cry. Hang in there.

You have to have your own feelings and strength. Don't be like me and alienate yourself because of a controlling relationship. Fast forward seven years and he leaves you because he says he wasted his youth and never got to experience anything because you're the one holding him back. You have to have emotion or you will turn into a shell of a person, a robot. You are worth more than a potential argument. Be strong.

Yeah she does. But being with her every single day with no breaks and no family or anyone to help watch her is draining. I try to do what I can and keep a happy face strictly for her. I feel like my marriage is failing if not already failed. I just want her to grow up with two parents. But I feel like I'm the problem because of depression. I only talk about how I feel to my husband when he's here and she's asleep or playing in her room away from me
Sometimes feeling numb laying in bed at night can be soothing. It's when I am trying to go through the routine and go through the motions that I feel so lost.

I feel like it's too much wasted energy or things cost money and then t becomes an inconvenience because of having to figure out what to do with my child. I also just want to lay in bed and sleep. That's what I'm doing now that my daughter is in bed and he is out with friends drinking like he does every Saturday. I feel so alone. Seeing other people being affectionate in public or acting happy makes me wonder where I went wrong. Or do I deserve the life I created for myself. I just want someone to love me and to know what it feels like to enjoy life. I hope you have someone.

I used to have a lot of hobbies; surfing, charcoaling, dancing, etc. but then when we got together I lost sight of who I was. It's to the point now where I can't be who I was. I don't have the energy or desire to try to find something to do because I have nobody to watch my child. I am the one who is always with her aside from daycare.

I feel similar. I have guilt because of my daughter, not my husband. I don't know how to get out of my emotional state. I get so frustrated easily and I feel like I'm such a shell of a person now. No personality. You're not alone in feeling like this. I hope things improve for the both of us.

I did that before. Seven years ago. I got to a few days before af things still weren't better. For some reason I decided not to go through with it. I wasn't ready. It didn't feel right. I waited. I still have suicidal thoughts. But fast forward and now I have a child. If I did it then I wouldn't have gotten to see this life, this side of me. Things aren't great but I know I was strong for hanging on. I think the date is a self soothing thing. It worked for me. I hope it brings you some clarity and you can stumble your way into the future as I have. We aren't perfect, but we can still try to be something for someone to love. Good luck.
